rooms.description: This is part of a spongy gray maze of twisty little synapses, all alike.
rooms.title: Maze

rooms.description: This is the heart of the Beast's lair. The only exit leads northeast.
rooms.title: Inner Lair

rooms.description: This airlock has massive doors to port and starboard.
rooms.title: Airlock

rooms.description: This is the enclosed front porch of your home. Your front garden lies to the south, and you can re-enter your home to the north.
rooms.title: Front Porch

rooms.description: The wind moans. Dust drifts across the surface of the alien world. Zaphod, Ford, and Trillian appear and urge you forward.
rooms.title: Ramp

rooms.description: This is an entry bay for the Heart of Gold. A corridor lies aft of here.
rooms.title: Entry Bay Number Two

rooms.description: You are in the stomach of a sperm whale. You can hear a distant sound of rushing wind.
rooms.title: Inside the Sperm Whale

rooms.description: This is a small closet with an exit to starboard.
rooms.title: Marvin's Pantry
